name: Egg fried rice
steps: Beat the eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, pour in the eggs, and scramble about 1 minute until just set; move them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the white parts of the green onions, and the peas; cook 1–2 minutes.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and fry 3–4 minutes until hot and starting to crisp in spots.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, the eggs, and the green onion tops, toss for 30 seconds, and serve.

name: Vegetable stir-fry
steps: Stir the soy sauce, cornstarch, and 3 tbsp water together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the carrots and broccoli and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and mushrooms and stir-fry 3 more minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and stir about 1 minute until glossy and thickened.
Serve over hot rice.

name: Beef and broccoli

ingredients.note: flank or sirloin, sliced thin against the grain

steps: Toss the steak with 1 tsp of the cornstarch and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce. Mix the remaining soy sauce, brown sugar, remaining cornstarch, and 1/3 cup water in a bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the beef in one layer and sear 1–2 minutes per side until browned and no longer pink on the outside; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the broccoli with 2 tbsp water, cover, and cook 3 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, return the beef, pour in the sauce, and stir 1–2 minutes until thickened.
Serve over rice.

name: Garlic soy chicken

ingredients.note: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, and 2 tbsp water in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in one layer and cook 6–8 minutes, turning, until browned and it reaches 165°F inside.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic, and stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes, stirring, until it coats the chicken.
Top with green onions and serve over rice.

name: Teriyaki chicken

ingredients.note: rice vinegar if you have it

steps: Whisk the soy sauce, brown sugar, vinegar, ginger, cornstarch, and 3 tbsp water in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5–6 minutes per side until golden and it reaches 165°F inside.
Turn the heat to low, pour in the sauce, and simmer 1–2 minutes, turning the chicken, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Slice the chicken, spoon the sauce over, and serve with rice.

name: Sweet and sour chicken
steps: Stir the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, 1 tsp of the cornstarch, and 1/4 cup water together for the sauce.
Toss the chicken in the remaining cornstarch with a pinch of salt.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chicken 6–8 minutes, turning, until golden and it reaches 165°F inside; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the onion, and the bell pepper and stir-fry 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour in the sauce and stir 1–2 minutes until thick, then return the chicken, toss to coat, and serve with rice if you like.

name: Peanut noodles
steps: Cook the noodles in salted boiling water according to the package; save 1/2 cup of the cooking water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, garlic, and sesame oil in a large bowl until smooth.
Add the hot noodles and toss, splashing in cooking water a little at a time until the sauce is creamy and coats everything.
Top with green onions and cucumber and serve warm or cold.

name: Upgraded ramen (egg and green onion)
steps: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a small pot over high heat. Add the ramen noodles and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the seasoning packet, then crack the egg into the pot, turn the heat to medium, cover, and simmer 3 minutes until the white is set.
Pour into a bowl and add the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with the green onions and a few drops of hot sauce if you like.

name: Chicken lo mein
steps: Cook the noodles in boiling water according to the package, drain, and rinse briefly. Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken 5–6 minutes until no longer pink inside and it reaches 165°F; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the carrots, and the cabbage and stir-fry 3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles, chicken, and sauce and toss 1–2 minutes until everything is hot and coated.

name: Ginger soy salmon
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic in a small bowl. Pat the salmon dry.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin-side up 4 minutes until golden, then flip.
Lower the heat to medium and cook 3–4 minutes more until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork (145°F).
Pour the sauce into the pan and spoon it over the fish for 30–60 seconds until slightly thick. Top with green onions.

name: Korean-style ground beef bowl
steps: Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Cook the ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned with no pink left and it reaches 160°F. Spoon off extra fat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes, stirring, until most of the liquid is absorbed. Add red pepper flakes to taste.
Serve over rice topped with green onions.

name: Spicy garlic tofu
steps: Toss the tofu cubes in the cornstarch with a pinch of salt. Mix the soy sauce, honey, hot sauce, and 2 tbsp water in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on all sides.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic, and stir 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and toss 1 minute until sticky. Top with green onions and serve with rice.

name: Tofu and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch, and 1/4 cup water in a bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu 8 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the broccoli with 2 tbsp water, cover, and cook 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, return the tofu, pour in the sauce, and stir 1 minute until thickened. Serve over rice.

name: Oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl)

ingredients.note: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Combine the broth, soy sauce, and sugar in a medium skillet and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the onion and simmer 3 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken in one layer, cover, and simmer 6–8 minutes, turning once, until it reaches 165°F inside.
Lightly beat the eggs and pour them over the chicken. Cover and cook on low 2–3 minutes until the eggs are set (no longer runny).
Divide the rice between bowls, slide the chicken and egg on top with some sauce, and sprinkle with green onions.

name: Chicken katsu
steps: Season the chicken cutlets with salt. Set out three plates: flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs.
Coat each cutlet in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into the panko on both sides.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat until a crumb sizzles. Fry the chicken 4–5 minutes per side until deep golden and it reaches 165°F inside.
Drain on a paper towel and rest 2 minutes. Meanwhile stir the ketchup, soy sauce, and honey together for a quick katsu sauce.
Slice the chicken into strips and serve with the sauce and rice or shredded cabbage.

name: Thai-style basil chicken
steps: Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, and 2 tbsp water in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the garlic and jalapeno and stir 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and stir-fry 6–7 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 165°F.
Pour in the sauce and cook 1 minute, then turn off the heat and stir in the basil until just wilted.
Serve over rice (a fried egg on top is traditional).

name: Spicy cabbage stir-fry

ingredients.note: small head, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and stir 30 seconds until fragrant, not brown.
Turn the heat to high, add the cabbage, and stir-fry 4–5 minutes until wilted but still a little crisp.
Pour in the sauce, toss 30 seconds, and serve with rice.

name: Ginger soy pork chops
steps: Mix the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, honey, and 2 tbsp water in a small bowl. Pat the pork chops dry.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the pork 4–5 minutes per side until golden and it reaches 145°F inside.
Lower the heat, pour in the sauce, and simmer 1 minute, turning the chops to glaze them.
Rest the chops 3 minutes, then slice and serve over rice with the pan sauce.

name: Shrimp and vegetable stir-fry
steps: Mix the soy sauce, cornstarch, and 3 tbsp water in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over high heat. Cook the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the broccoli, and the bell pepper and stir-fry 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, return the shrimp, pour in the sauce, and stir 1 minute until glossy. Serve with rice.

name: Coconut chicken curry

ingredients.note: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir 2 minutes to coat, then pour in the coconut milk and 1/4 cup water and bring to a simmer.
Add the bell pepper and simmer 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken reaches 165°F inside.
Squeeze in the lime juice, season with salt, and serve with rice.

name: Chana masala
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 6–8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and cumin and stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened.
Stir in the chickpeas and 1/2 cup water, then simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
Squeeze in the lemon juice, season with salt, and top with cilantro. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Red lentil dal
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and cumin and stir 1 minute.
Add the lentils, 3 cups water, and the tomatoes if using. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered 20 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils break down into a thick soup; add a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Butter chicken

ingredients.note: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion 6 minutes until soft and light golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute, then stir in the tomato paste and cook 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir to coat, then pour in 3/4 cup water and simmer, covered, 12–15 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F inside.
Stir in the cream, sugar, remaining butter, and salt to taste, and simmer 2–3 minutes until creamy.
Serve with rice or naan.

name: Yogurt-marinated chicken (tandoori-style, oven)
steps: Stir the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, curry powder, paprika, cumin, and salt together in a bowl.
Add the chicken, coat well, cover, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes (up to overnight).
Heat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush it with the oil.
Lay the chicken on the sheet, letting extra marinade drip off, and bake 20–25 minutes until charred at the edges and it reaches 165°F inside.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with rice, naan, or a salad.

name: Aloo gobi
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan with a lid over medium heat. Add the cumin and onion and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower, tomato, 1 tsp salt, and 1/4 cup water; stir to coat.
Cover and cook on medium-low 20–25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the potatoes are fork-tender; add a splash of water if it sticks.
Uncover and cook 2–3 minutes more to dry slightly. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Egg curry
steps: Place the eggs in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Cover, turn off the heat, and let sit 10 minutes until the yolks are firm. Cool in cold water and peel.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion 6–8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Stir in the coconut milk (or 1/2 cup water) and salt to taste. Cut shallow slits in the eggs, add them to the sauce, and simmer 5 minutes, spooning sauce over.
Serve with rice or naan.

name: Coconut shrimp curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, and tomato paste and stir 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a simmer, and cook 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the shrimp and simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until pink and opaque all the way through.
Squeeze in the lime juice, season with salt, and serve with rice.

name: Vegetable korma
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry powder and stir 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, carrots, cauliflower, coconut milk, and 1/2 cup water. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 15–18 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the peas and cook 3 minutes more. Season with salt and serve with rice or naan.

name: Jeera (cumin) rice

ingredients.note: whole seeds if you have them

steps: Melt the butter in a medium pot over medium heat. Add the cumin and stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the rinsed rice and stir 1 minute to coat.
Add 1 3/4 cups water and the salt, bring to a boil, then cover, turn the heat to low, and cook 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and leave covered 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.

name: Cucumber raita
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber in your hands or a towel to remove extra water.
Stir the cucumber into the yogurt with the cumin and a pinch of salt.
Add the chopped herbs if using, and chill until ready to serve alongside curry or rice.
